## Series Overview

Every week I pick a handful of the most relevant papers from arXiv and the HF Daily Papers list — filtered against my own work (semiconductor X-ray/casting defect detection, VLM fine-tuning, auto-label verification) — and write each one up twice: once so a 5-year-old could follow it, once with the full methodology, a code sketch, and an honest note on whether it's actually useful for what I'm building.

**Papers covered so far:** 12

**By topic:** Vision-Language Models (4), Reasoning & Agents (3), Segmentation (2), Benchmarks & Evaluation (1), Model Efficiency (1), Reinforcement Learning (1), Self-Supervised Learning (1)
